what.text: Deepak Nitrite Limited specializes in manufacturing advanced intermediates and specialty chemicals. The company focuses on operational excellence, sustainability, and innovation to create long-term value.

segments.name: Advanced Intermediates
segments.text: This segment includes specialized products such as nitrites, nitro toluidines, fuel additives, and specialty agrochemicals.

snapshot.text: The dividend yield is low at 0.46%.

trajectory.text: Annual revenue declined from ₹8,282 Cr in FY25 to ₹7,887 Cr in FY26.
Net profit decreased significantly from ₹697 Cr in FY25 to ₹551 Cr in FY26.
Trailing twelve-month revenue is ₹9,749 Cr, with a net profit of ₹1,062 Cr.

balance_sheet.text: Total borrowings increased from ₹1,638 Cr in FY26 to ₹1,762 Cr by Sep 2026.
Shareholders' equity rose to ₹6,475 Cr by Sep 2026.
Debt-to-equity ratio is stable at 0.3 as of Sep 2026.

cash_quality.text: Free cash flow has been negative for the last two fiscal years.
Cumulative cash from operations is 88% of cumulative net profit over FY22–FY26.
Cash conversion cycle increased to 92 days in FY26.
